trace.query: What is the difference between a COR and a COG?
trace.answer_for_eval: A COR (Certificate of Registration) is a document issued to a licensed professional, confirming their registration to practice. A COG (Certificate of Good Standing) certifies that a professional is in good standing with their licensing body, indicating they have no pending violations or disciplinary actions.
